message.content:
In the repo /bench/home/work (a memos fork, Go backend), trace how a browser's HTTP request for ANOTHER user's profile image (avatar) reaches stored data. Likely an HTTP GET route like /file/users/{id}/avatar or similar registered in server/router/... (maybe frontend/ or api/v1 GetUserAvatar / GetUserAvatarBinary).

Give every hop from the HTTP route registration / serving handler down to the data layer:
- route registration (file:line)
- handler function (file:line)
- any intermediate service/store calls (e.g. GetUser, extracting avatar URL from user setting or User.AvatarURL field)
- the store method and the db driver method that reads the data (file:line)
- how the avatar bytes are decoded/served (e.g. base64 data-URI parsing)

Also note any visibility/permission check on that path. Report as a hop-per-line list: symbol — path:line.

## Avatar request path — hop-per-line

**Wiring / registration**
- `NewServer` → `fileserver.NewFileServerService(...)` — /bench/home/work/server/server.go:81
- `FileServerService.RegisterRoutes(echoServer)` — /bench/home/work/server/server.go:82
- `FileServerService.RegisterRoutes` — /bench/home/work/server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:121
- `fileGroup.GET("/users/:identifier/avatar", s.serveUserAvatar)` — /bench/home/work/server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:124 (group `/file` at :122; only global middleware is `Recover` + CORS, /bench/home/work/server/server.go:51-52 — no auth middleware on this group)

**Handler**
- `FileServerService.serveUserAvatar` — /bench/home/work/server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:168
- `Profile.AllowAnonymous` (the only gate) — /bench/home/work/internal/profile/profile.go:46 (returns true whenever `InstanceURL` is non-empty)
- `FileServerService.getCurrentUser` — /bench/home/work/server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:708
- `Authenticator.AuthenticateToUser` (Bearer/PAT, then refresh-token cookie) — /bench/home/work/server/auth/authenticator.go:190
- `identifier := c.Param("identifier")` — /bench/home/work/server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:183

**Service → store**
- `FileServerService.getUserByUsername` — /bench/home/work/server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:715 (builds `store.FindUser{Username: &identifier}` — username only, no ID form)
- `Store.GetUser` — /bench/home/work/store/user.go:148 (ID-keyed cache is skipped since `find.ID == nil`)
- `Store.ListUsers` — /bench/home/work/store/user.go:136 (also populates `userCache` by ID, :143)
- `driver.ListUsers` — /bench/home/work/store/db/sqlite/user.go:88 (Postgres /bench/home/work/store/db/postgres/user.go:87, MySQL /bench/home/work/store/db/mysql/user.go:84)
- SQL `SELECT id, username, role, email, nickname, password_hash, avatar_url, description, ... FROM user WHERE 1 = 1 AND username = ?` — /bench/home/work/store/db/sqlite/user.go:151-165 (username predicate at :128-130)
- `rows.Scan(... &user.AvatarURL ...)` — /bench/home/work/store/db/sqlite/user.go:189 (field decl `store.User.AvatarURL` — /bench/home/work/store/user.go:43)

**Decode / serve**
- `user.AvatarURL == ""` → 404 — /bench/home/work/server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:192
- `FileServerService.parseDataURI` — /bench/home/work/server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:737
- `dataURIRegex` = `^data:(?P<type>[^;]+);base64,(?P<base64>.+)` — /bench/home/work/server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:98
- `base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString(matches[2])` — /bench/home/work/server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:744
- `avatarAllowedTypes[imageType]` MIME allowlist — /bench/home/work/server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:201 (map at :75)
- `setSecurityHeaders` (nosniff, X-Frame-Options DENY, CSP `default-src 'none'`) — /bench/home/work/server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:205 / definition :758
- `Cache-Control: public, max-age=3600` — /bench/home/work/server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:207 (const :49)
- `c.Blob(http.StatusOK, imageType, imageData)` — /bench/home/work/server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:209

**How the browser gets this URL**
- `convertUserFromStore` rewrites base64 avatars to `/file/users/{username}/avatar` — /bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/user_service_converters.go:36 (raw non-data-URI values pass through at :38)

## Visibility / permission observations

- The **only** check on this route is the instance-wide anonymous gate (fileserver.go:173-181). If `Profile.InstanceURL` is set (`AllowAnonymous() == true`), the handler performs **no authentication at all** — any unauthenticated caller can fetch any user's avatar by guessing/knowing a username.
- When authentication *is* required, it only verifies that *some* valid viewer exists (`viewer == nil` → 401, fileserver.go:178). There is no relationship, role, or per-target-user visibility check between `viewer` and the target `user` — contrast with `checkAttachmentPermission` (/bench/home/work/server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:650) which does real per-object authorization for attachments, and with `canViewerAccessUserEmail` (/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/user_service_converters.go:44) which gates the email field.
- `store.FindUser` is built with `Username` only, no `RowStatus` filter (fileserver.go:716), so avatars of archived/deactivated users are still served (driver applies `row_status` only when `find.RowStatus != nil`, /bench/home/work/store/db/sqlite/user.go:125).
- An error from `getCurrentUser` is mapped to 500 rather than 401 (fileserver.go:176) — invalid/expired tokens surface as server errors.
- `/memos.api.v1.UserService/GetUserAvatar` is listed as an unauthenticated-allowed method in /bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/acl_config.go:25, but I found no Go implementation of that RPC anywhere under `server/` — the binary avatar path in this fork is exclusively the Echo `/file/users/:identifier/avatar` route above.
